releaseNotes: Accounts can be renamed, including Bank, Cash and UPI. Call them what your bank calls them - HDFC Bank, SBI - and every past transaction moves with the name
Add an account and its balance in one step, instead of adding it and then setting the balance separately

Name a payment method after the account it spends from and it links itself: UPI-HDFC draws on HDFC, Card SBI draws on SBI. You can still set it by hand, and the guess never overrides a choice you made
Settings now lists every account with its balance, not just a fixed Bank and Cash pair
Installs over the top of 3.6.0 or later
